articles.summary: Today Emera (TSX/NYSE: EMA) announced that it will release its Q3 2026 results and outline its 5-year capital and funding plan on Friday, November 6, 2026, before markets open. The Company will host a teleconference and webcast the same day at 9:30 a.m. Atlantic (8:30 a.m. Eastern) to discuss the results. Analysts and other interested parties in North America are invited to participate by dialing 1-800-717-1738. International parties are invited to participate by dialing 1-289-514-5100. Participants should dial in at least 10 minutes prior to the start of the call. No pass code is required. A live and archived audio webcast of the teleconference will be available on the Company's website, www.emera.com . A replay of the teleconference will be available on the Company’s website two hours after the conclusion of the call. articles.summary: Emera Inc. (TSX/NYSE: EMA) today announces that its Board of Directors have approved an increase in the company’s quarterly dividend on its common share to $0.74 per share. The new quarterly dividend represents an annualized dividend of $2.96, a 1% increase from the previous annual dividend of $2.93 per share. “This increase marks our 20th consecutive year of dividend growth, underscoring the strength of our business and our commitment to delivering stable, sustainable returns to shareholders,” said Scott Balfour, President and CEO of Emera Inc. “The continued growth in our dividend is supported by our forecasted 7-8% rate base growth and 5-7% average adjusted earnings per share 1 growth target through 2030.” Emera continues to prioritize the enhancement of shareholder value through disciplined financial management and a robust growth strategy.
